text:
maya: APAC promotion for payments v1.12.3 failed during canary in ap-southeast. Pods are ImagePullBackOff. deploy-bot shows different image digest across registries. Anyone watching the registry mirror?

deploy-bot: [PROMOTE] release=payments chart=payments version=1.12.3 -> region=ap-southeast
  event=pod_image_pull_failed
  expected=sha256:ef01c9...
  actual=sha256:9f2b7a...
  error=BlobUnknown

simon: probable mirror lag. pinging registry infra. We should prevent automated retries to ap-southeast until we confirm parity.

registry-bot: mirror-status job=mirror-payments last_attempt=2026-03-21T10:11:02Z status=partial synced=413/416 eta=~3m

maya: my proposal: pause further regional promotions to ap-southeast for 30m, apply a temporary image pin in that region to the last-good digest so live traffic isn't affected, and record the delay in release notes. If mirror finishes, re-run promotion with digest verification. Thoughts?

jen: +1. To pin quickly we can helm upgrade with explicit image.digest set to known-good sha and reuse-values. Example:

```
helm upgrade payments ./charts/payments --namespace payments \
  --set image.tag=1.12.2 --set image.digest=sha256:9f2b7a... --reuse-values --timeout 5m
```

Also will add a short blurb in release notes: "ap-southeast promotion delayed due to registry mirror lag; pinned to previous digest to preserve availability."

simon: also add a deploy-bot exclude so it won't auto-retry ap-southeast while we investigate: `deploybot.exclusions.add("ap-southeast", release=payments)`

maya: done — added temporary exclusion for this promotion. deploy-bot acknowledged pause.

tk: oncall ack. Opening INC-2026-034 and escalating registry mirror job. If we need to rollback app canary, what are the quick commands?

jen: rollback snippets: 
```
# check rollout
kubectl -n payments rollout status deploy/payments
# rollback helm to previous revision
helm rollback payments 3 --namespace payments
# or set image to known-good digest
kubectl -n payments set image deployment/payments payments=registry.redwood/payments:1.12.2@sha256:9f2b7a...
```

Smoke check: `curl -fS https://payments-ap-southeast.internal/health`

deploy-bot: promotion paused; will not retry ap-southeast until exclusion removed.

registry-bot: mirror job recovered at 2026-03-21T10:18:31Z, synced=416/416, integrity=pass

maya: ok once registry confirms parity we'll re-promote. Simon can you own the re-run? Steps: 1) confirm digest parity, 2) remove exclusion, 3) promote with --verify-digest, 4) run smoke tests and keep rollback window open 15m.

simon: on it. Quick checklist after sync:
  1) `skopeo inspect docker://registry.eu-west/payments:1.12.3` -> sha256:ef01c9...
  2) `skopeo inspect docker://registry.ap-southeast/payments:1.12.3` -> sha256:ef01c9...
  3) remove exclusion and run: `deployctl promote --release payments --chart payments --version 1.12.3 --verify-digest`
  4) smoke tests; rollback window 15m.

jen: release notes updated: "Regional promotion for payments v1.12.3 delayed in ap-southeast due to transient registry mirror lag; temporary image pin applied to preserve availability. Re-promotion pending mirror parity (INC-2026-034)."

maya: summary: hold applied, manual pin in ap-southeast, incident opened, simon owns re-promotion. I'll post final status when done. :white_check_mark:
